text:
eva: Heads-up — intermittent resume bug in sample-app streaming. After an abort+reconnect the client sometimes gets a few stray control bytes, then fragments from multiple events concatenated out-of-order and JSON parser fails.
chong: reproable locally behind the dev proxy or also on prod?
eva: only on dev proxy (mitm) so far, never when connecting direct to backend. ~4% of reconnects during busy dev sessions.
maya: any raw bytes?
eva: sample snippet from capture:
[recv] 0x00 0x1b 0x7b 0x22 0x69 0x64 0x22  -> starts with NUL then '{"id"'
[recv] data: {"id":"m2","text":"second"}
[recv] data: {"id":"m1","text":"first"}
[parser] combined => '\u0000{"id":"m2","text":"second"}{"id":"m1","text":"first"}' -> JSON error
chong: could be pooling or buffer reuse in the proxy. Does token refresh sync up with reconnects? we've seen small auth POSTs interleaving before.
eva: yes sometimes an auth refresh is observed right before the reconnect. added repro steps to sample-app/streaming/REPRO.md (force short token TTL, trigger refresh during reconnect).
maya: short-term SDK mitigation ideas: 1) ignore leading control bytes (<=0x1f) until we hit printable data; 2) buffer incoming bytes and only split on SSE separator '\n\n' (avoid assuming per-chunk = per-event); 3) optional small reorder buffer keyed by event id/seq (buffer N=8, timeout 200ms) to smooth brief reorders. Log metrics when trimming/reordering.
eva: implemented a local patch that trims leading control bytes and buffers until '\n\n'. it fixed the flakiness in my runs. will open a feature-flagged PR.
chong: infra: please collect tcpdump on next repro and try toggling keepalive/pooling for the dev proxy instance. filing INF-1210.
infra-bot: INF-1210 created: "dev-proxy: investigate pooled connection writes and stray control bytes on resume".
devex-bot: DEX-1401 created: "streaming: defensive resume parsing + optional reorder buffer; investigate dev-proxy pooled writes".
maya: please ensure parser changes preserve SSE comments and retry lines. add unit tests for leading-control-byte trimming and interleaved writes.
eva: will add tests + attach pcap once infra provides. thanks all :thumbsup:
